analyst_view.overall: Early view: two in-form sides without European football meet on a Friday night: Brest won their last two league games without conceding, and Paris FC sit 3rd under Liam Rosenior. Brest's home record had been their weak spot (one win in their first four home games before beating Lyon), and Paris FC lost two away games in a row before winning at Auxerre.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.9 goals. I stay close to it: Brest's games average three goals and Paris FC's about 2.7. Brendan Chardonnet should be back from his calf problem by then, which would steady Brest's back line.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners. I lean lower: Brest play direct with little of the ball (one corner against Lyon) and Paris FC win only 3.6 a game (16th). Neither side relies on wide play to create.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards. I lean slightly higher: Brest are 4th for fouls (14.2 a game) and Paris FC 6th (13.9). A physical game between two sides that both commit fouls is likely to produce four or five bookings.

shots.text: The numbers say 23.2 shots. I lean higher: Brest average 16.1 shots a game (4th) and Paris FC 13.5 (5th). Brest's habit of shooting early and often should push the total above the site's figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.0 shots on target. I lean higher: Brest are 3rd for shots on target (5.7 a game) and Paris FC average 4.9. Nine or ten looks more likely than seven or eight.
